p9_b0.ocr: In the second quarter of fiscal year 2025, Rio Tinto reported significant financial metrics with total Revenue of $450M, Net Income of $120M, EBITDA of $200M, a Gross Margin of 30%, an Operating Margin of 27%, CAPEX of $50M, Operating Expenses of $180M, and a Net Profit Margin of 26.7% with a Production Volume of 150,000 tons.

p9_b1.ocr: For Q1 FY2025, the figures were Revenue at $400M, Net Income at $100M, and EBITDA at $180M, whereas Year-to-Date totals reached $850M in Revenue, $220M in Net Income, and $370M in EBITDA, reflecting a Revenue Growth of 12.5%.
